introduction: Please export only the files that apply. The request is limited to search visibility evidence for the next audit.

importance_definitions.required: Needed only to support the named claim or comparison. The audit can still be produced without it, with the limitation stated.
importance_definitions.recommended: Improves confidence in a visibility finding but is not essential.
importance_definitions.optional: Provide only when this source exists and can be exported safely.

deletion_policy: Supplied files are processed locally and deleted from the controlled intake directory after processing. Originals held by source platforms are not affected.

items.title: Owner context
items.exact_report: Canonical facts, target markets and languages, seasonality, controlled profiles, competitors, unresolved contradictions and known implementation dates
filters: Include only profiles controlled by the organization
Mark unresolved contradictions instead of choosing an unsupported version
items.rationale: Confirms the canonical facts and comparison context that public visibility evidence should represent, including seasonality and dated site changes.
export_instructions: Prepare a short file from existing materials and state when each known implementation went live.
List controlled profiles and named competitors separately.
Keep unresolved contradictions visible for validation.
If the source is a Google Sheet, export it as XLSX or CSV instead of sharing a connected sheet.
items.anonymization: Remove personal information and internal notes that are not needed to define the public scope.
items.claim_supported: The audited topics, languages and markets match the owner's stated public scope.

items.title: Google Search Console search performance
filters: Other relevant search types such as Image, Video or News in separate exports
items.rationale: Supports query, page, market and device visibility trends across the longest supported comparison window.
export_instructions: Export each requested dimension and search type as a separate structured file.
A normal Search Console UI export provides up to 1,000 representative rows; state that limitation when it reduces coverage.
items.anonymization: Remove query or page rows that contain personal information before supplying the export.
items.condition: Always provide when the property has data.
items.claim_supported: Organic Google visibility changed by query, landing page, market or device during the comparison period.

items.title: Google Search Console page indexing
items.date_range: Current snapshot and available history, up to 16 months
filters: All known pages for the audited canonical domain
Separate indexed and not indexed states
items.rationale: Distinguishes visibility limits caused by indexing state from changes in search demand.
export_instructions: Export the summary and each indexing-reason table separately.
Include representative example URLs for every material reason.
items.anonymization: Remove private or personal URL values before supplying the export.
items.condition: Always provide when the property has indexing data.
items.claim_supported: Material public page groups are indexed or excluded for the reasons shown in Search Console.

items.title: Google Search Console sitemaps
filters: Submitted sitemaps for the audited canonical domain
items.rationale: Shows whether declared public URL inventories are current, readable and aligned with indexing evidence.
export_instructions: Export the full sitemap table with status, dates and discovered-item counts.
items.anonymization: Remove sitemap paths that expose private environments or tokens.
items.condition: Always provide when one or more sitemaps are submitted.
items.claim_supported: Submitted sitemaps are current, readable and representative of the public URL inventory.

items.title: Google Search Console Core Web Vitals
items.date_range: Current snapshot and available history, up to 16 months
items.rationale: Supports page-experience visibility findings with grouped field-data status rather than isolated lab tests.
export_instructions: Export mobile and desktop summaries separately.
Include the LCP, INP or CLS issue and representative URL groups.
items.anonymization: Remove private or personal URL values before supplying the export.
items.condition: Always provide when Core Web Vitals field data is available.
items.claim_supported: Public URL groups have the reported Core Web Vitals status on mobile or desktop.

items.title: Google Search Console crawl stats
filters: Keep hosts and crawler types separate
items.rationale: Shows whether host availability, response patterns or crawler allocation constrain discovery of public pages.
export_instructions: Export the time trend and every crawl-request breakdown as separate structured files.
items.anonymization: Remove private hostnames and URL examples before supplying the export.
items.condition: Always provide when crawl statistics are available.
items.claim_supported: Googlebot reached the audited hosts with the reported response and crawl-allocation pattern.

items.title: GA4 Organic Search visibility trend
items.exact_report: Reports > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition, plus landing-page trend
filters: Session default channel group exactly Organic Search
Keep separate from AI Assistant traffic
items.rationale: Shows search-discovery traffic and landing-page trends without mixing in other channels or business outcomes.
export_instructions: Export the time trend and landing-page table separately.
Keep only sessions and users as metrics.
items.anonymization: Remove user-level identifiers and retain only aggregated rows.
items.condition: Always provide when the property has data.
items.claim_supported: Organic Search sessions, users and landing-page visibility changed during the comparison period.

items.title: GA4 AI Assistant visibility baseline
items.exact_report: Traffic acquisition exploration with an AI Assistant source grouping
items.rationale: Establishes a separate AI discovery baseline without folding it into Organic Search.
export_instructions: Export the time trend and landing-page table separately.
A zero-row or zero-session export is a valid baseline and should be supplied, not treated as missing data.
items.anonymization: Remove user-level identifiers and retain only aggregated rows.
items.condition: Always provide, including a valid zero baseline.
items.claim_supported: AI Assistant visibility has a measured positive or zero baseline distinct from Organic Search.

items.title: Merchant Center product visibility
items.exact_report: Performance report and Needs attention diagnostics
items.date_range: Latest 12 months, or the longest available period
filters: Separate paid traffic from organic traffic
items.rationale: Connects product discoverability with feed and account-level visibility constraints.
export_instructions: Export performance by product and country.
Export product issues and account issues as separate structured files.
items.anonymization: Remove supplier-only notes or personal information not needed for product diagnostics.
items.condition: Provide only for an e-commerce entity with Merchant Center data.

items.title: Google Business Profile facts and visibility
items.exact_report: Profile facts, Performance and Google updates
items.date_range: Latest 12 months, or the longest available period
items.rationale: Checks whether local profile facts and Google changes align with observed local-search visibility.
export_instructions: Export structured performance tables where available.
Use PDF or screenshots only for profile facts or Google updates that have no structured export.
items.anonymization: Remove personal reviewer or staff information not needed for the visibility review.
items.condition: Provide only for a local entity with one or more Business Profiles.

items.title: Bing Webmaster Tools evidence
items.exact_report: Search Performance, URL Inspection, Sitemaps and crawl issues
items.date_range: Latest 12 months, or the longest available period
items.rationale: Adds a second search engine view of performance, indexing, sitemaps and crawl constraints.
export_instructions: Export performance with query and page breakdowns.
Export indexing, sitemap and crawl-issue lists separately.
items.anonymization: Remove personal information from query or URL rows before supplying the files.
items.condition: Provide only if Bing Webmaster Tools is already used and exports are available.

items.title: Sanitized search-crawler logs
items.source: Existing web server or edge logs
items.exact_report: Sanitized requests from recognized search crawlers
items.rationale: Can confirm whether important public paths are reached by search crawlers.
export_instructions: Supply an existing sanitized aggregate export only.
items.anonymization: Remove IP addresses, cookies, query values, personal identifiers and private paths; aggregate rows where possible.
items.condition: Provide only if a sanitized export already exists or can be prepared safely.

items.title: Existing crawl export
items.exact_report: Internal HTML URL, status, indexability, canonical and link summary export
items.rationale: Provides a point-in-time technical visibility inventory for comparison with the audit crawl.
export_instructions: Export the existing crawl as a structured file; do not start a new crawl only for this request.
items.anonymization: Remove staging hosts, private URLs, tokens and personal information before supplying the export.
items.condition: Provide only if a relevant crawl export already exists.

items.title: Existing AI visibility monitoring export
items.exact_report: Prompt, engine, date, citation and cited-URL observation export
filters: Audited entity and public domain only
items.rationale: Adds historical observations when the organization already monitors AI-search visibility.
export_instructions: Export the existing observation table with its prompt and market definitions.
items.anonymization: Remove user identities, private prompts and unrelated entities before supplying the export.
items.condition: Provide only if AI visibility monitoring is already in use and an export exists.
